segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Thank you very much Madam Chair for the opportunity.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: For fiscal year 2027, the proposed national expenditure program or NEP budget

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: for the DepEd is P975.96 billion including funding for attached agencies

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: namely the National Book Development Board, NBDB, P169.9 million,

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: National Council for Children's Television, P76 million,

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: National Museum of the Philippines, P1.56 billion,

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Philippine High School for the Arts, P135.3 million,

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Teacher Education Council, P360.3 million,

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: and the National Academy of Sports, P258.5 million.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: This slide presents the comparative budget for the 2026 NEP, 2026 GAA, and 2027 NEP, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: The 2027 NEP level budget amounts to P975.96 billion as mentioned earlier

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: which is P39.35 billion lower

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: than the 2026 GAA.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Karamihan po sa ating attached agencies ay nakapagtala ng lower budget levels

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: for fiscal year 2027 compared to the fiscal year 2026 GAA

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: except for the National Museum of the Philippines which received a higher proposed allocation.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Next slide please.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: This slide, Madam Chair, Your Honors, presents the comparison of the 2026 NEP versus GAA versus 2027 NEP.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: For DepEd proper alone.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So, personal services continues to go up and represents about 79% of the total budget

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: at around P766 billion approximately.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: MOOE and capital outlay both decreased compared to the 2026 GAA.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: MOOE declined by P33 billion while capital outlay records a large decrease of P67 billion.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Ito po yung overall picture.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Next slide please.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: This slide presents the budget utilization rate of DepEd which obligation stands at 51.54%

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: as of August 20, 2026 and disbursement rate of 89.28%, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Next slide please.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: This slide Madam Chair, Your Honors, presents some of the highlights of the 2027 NEP.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Starting with personnel improvements.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So, we start with the expanded career progression where we target to promote more than 135,000 teachers and school heads

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: with a corresponding allocation of 12.09 billion.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Naglaan din po tayo ng 3.75 billion para sa training ng mahigit 500,000 teachers and laptops for 50,000 teachers, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: For the learning environment, we have 17.31 billion to put up over 4,000 classrooms.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Sa aspeto naman po ng digital transformation, bukod sa nabanggit na laptops,

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: meron din pong 3.37 billion para sa internet renewal of over 14,000 schools, ICT solutions and capacity building.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: We also have allocated 6.4 billion for the production and procurement of textbooks and workbooks and other learning materials.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: And for inclusive education, we have 2.63 billion to support special needs education,

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: indigenous peoples education, madrasa education, multigrade education, alternative modes and alternative learning systems or ALS.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: For the feeding program, 11.43 billion was allocated to support 3.69 million learners.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: We're also asking additional for inclusive education as well as governance and innovation.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: And of course, our attached agencies also have their respective requests, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: The National Book Development Board is requesting an additional 186 million.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: For book fairs, readership promotion, policy development, research and advocacy,

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: the National Council for Children's Television is requesting an additional 61 million

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: for child-friendly, educational and values-oriented TV content, research and ICT support.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: The National Museum of the Philippines is requesting an additional 255 million

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: for digital transformation, public access, museum engagement and component museums nationwide.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: The Philippine High School for the Arts is requesting an additional 161 million

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: for campus rehabilitation, facilities and equipment, student support and quality arts education.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: The National Academy of Sports is requesting an additional 580 million

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: for sports development, competitions, student-athlete support, curriculum and facilities.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: And the Teacher Education Council is requesting an additional 498 million for salaries,

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: teacher education and graduate scholarships, and regional hubs.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So, ito po yung some of the salient points

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: of the 27 budget, Your Honor, and the resource persons, including myself,

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: are most willing to answer any questions from the distinguished members of the committee.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Madam Chair, thank you very much.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Carmen S. Zamora
segments.text: Thank you very much, Secretary Angara.

segments.text: Good morning, Madam Chair, and best wishes to our favorite department. Thank you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Carmen S. Zamora
segments.text: Representative Milagros Magsaysay,

segments.text: Deputy Speaker Janet Garin,

segments.text: Representative Renee Co.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Carmen S. Zamora
segments.text: May I remind our distinguished colleagues

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Carmen S. Zamora
segments.text: that each member is allotted five minutes for questions or interpellation,

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Carmen S. Zamora
segments.text: excluding the responses of the resource persons.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Carmen S. Zamora
segments.text: The Chair first now recognizes,

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Carmen S. Zamora
segments.text: the member of the minority.

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Carmen S. Zamora
segments.text: So allow me to recognize Representative Perci Cendaña

segments.speaker: Rep. Maria Carmen S. Zamora
segments.text: for the first question.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Madam Chair,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: at magandang umaga po sa ating lahat.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Bago po magsimula, baka pwede po muna itong bilangin sa aking five minutes,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: gusto ko lamang pong batiin lahat ng mga guro na narito na Happy Teacher's Month po sa inyo.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Para pong mahina yung palakpak for our teachers,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: pwede na pong magsimula yung five minutes, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Sige po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: This is a very pressing matter because of what has been happening in our schools the past few months.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Madam Chair, nakababahala po na mismo ang EDCOM 2 nakita na ang Pilipinas na ngayon ang bullying capital of the world.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Inuulit ko po, hindi ito magandang klase ng gold medal.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Ito yung gold medal na dapat hindi natin sinusuot with pride.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Again, the Philippines is the bullying capital of the world.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: This is saddening as it is alarming dahil alam nating bumababa ang learning competencies ng ating mga studyante kapag nabubully sila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Bullying is also among the reasons pointed out why the recent cases of school violence happened and why it is alarmingly increasing.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Kaya nga po, kahit ako hindi nakaligtas sa bullying,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: from no less than a school principal, shout out po sa principal ang Dimasalang High School, National High School po sa Masbate.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Madam Chair, we'd like to ask the DepEd, ano po ang plano ng DepEd para mapigilan ang bullying at karahasan within our schools?

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: We have a lot of programs and we're looking at, magandang umaga, Perci.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: We're looking at full implementation of the anti-bullying law, revised anti-bullying law.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: And in the last year, we've seen a, dumami na po talaga yung functioning child protection committees which is a requirement of the anti-bullying law.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: I think if I'm not mistaken, we have over 30,000, there are over 36,000 of our schools already have functioning child protection committees.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: And ang ginawa po namin dahil nakita po ng EDCOM nga na iilan lang po ang dati-dati-rati, about a year and a half ago, ang may functioning child protection committees.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So, that's one. And the second is under the new mental health and well-being law, we're ramping up the hiring.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: In fact, we shortened the time for the hiring of the school council associates.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Normally, this would take three to four months because our HROD, headed by Willie Cabral, looked for a way to shorten the hiring process.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Naibaba na namin sa halos 30 days, Your Honor, yung hiring process ng school council associates.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So, definitely, we're looking at that. We're looking at that. We're looking at that. We're looking at that. We're looking at that. We're looking at that.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So, definitely, I think dapat palakasin talaga yung approach in schools and building a stronger sense of community, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So, these are some of the things we're trying to do.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: And of course, training our, kahit yung mga eskwelahan na walang guidance counsellor, which is a systemic problem, as pointed out also by EDCOM.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: E, itatrain na lang sa suho natin sana yung mga guro, how to deal with problems like this.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: And of course, we're also trying to foster the larger community.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: We're also trying to foster the larger community, including the parents, para masabihan din yung mga bata.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Because as we all know, the origins of bullying are quite complex and many have origins in the household, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Mr. Secretary, bahagi po noong IRR ng Anti-Bullying Act ay ang designation ng Learner Information Officers.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Kumusta po ang status ng designation ng ating mga LFOs?

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: We've ramped it up, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: In fact, 100% ang LFOs.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: Ang pag-designate natin ng Learner Formation Officers.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: So all of our schools have a Learner Formation Officer, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Thank you.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Mr. Secretary, Madam Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Lumipat naman po tayo doon sa isang issue na napakalapit po sa puso ng maraming mga magulang na narito ngayon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Lalong-lalo na po yung mga magulang ng mga pupils, learners, children with special needs.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Noong nakaraang budget po ay pinaglaban ng Akbayan na maibalik ang pondo ng Special Needs Education Program ng DepEd.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Pero na-cut na naman po ang budget ng programa for 2027.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: pesos. Bakit po kaya

segments.text: nagkaroon na ganitong cut sa budget ng

segments.text: the NEP to NEP, NEP comparing

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: 26 NEP to 27 NEP,

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: actually, pantay lang siya. So, in that sense,

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara
segments.text: 1.04 billion ng 2026

segments.text: GAA, it represents a,

segments.text: the learning outcomes, Your Honor.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara

segments.text: So, and then, ang gusto nga po natin is ma-expand yung aral program to math and science later on.

segments.text: Dahil yung nagawa po lang natin is reading, aral reading.

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara

segments.text: Dahil for the first time in history,

segments.text: at nagpapasalamat muli tayo sa Kongreso kay Pangulong Marcos,

segments.speaker: DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara

segments.speaker: Rep. Rosanna "Ria" V. Vergara
segments.text: The internet is a double-edged sword, a tool for convenience which anyone with Wi-Fi access or a data plan may use, and if done so improperly, abuse.

segments.speaker: Presentation video
segments.text: Noong May 15, 2017, naghatid ng isang privileged speech si Congresswoman Vergara upang magbigay babala sa mga panganib na dulot ng internet, lalo na sa mga kabataan.

segments.speaker: Presentation video
segments.text: Isa sa mga sinusulong na batas ni Congresswoman Rosana Ria Vergara

segments.speaker: Presentation video
segments.text: ay ang House Bill 5666, o an act to integrate internet and social media education as part of the curriculum of all primary and secondary schools, public and private.

segments.speaker: Presentation video
segments.text: Ang pangunahing layuni ng panukalang batas na ito ay bumuo ng isang pangasiwaan na magbabantay at magtuturo sa mga mag-aaral ng wasto at maingat na paggamit ng internet.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rosanna "Ria" V. Vergara
segments.text: I will file a House Bill that will require the Department of Education, a subject that will specifically deal with the internet.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rosanna "Ria" V. Vergara
segments.text: and social media awareness, and the dangers and risks posed to the young by internet access that include the danger of internet gaming.

segments.speaker: Presentation video
segments.text: Ilan sa mga panganib na kanyang tinukoy ay ang pagsusugal at adiksyon sa mga internet games.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rosanna "Ria" V. Vergara
segments.text: How can a game be the reason for skipping class and losing money?

segments.speaker: Rep. Rosanna "Ria" V. Vergara
segments.text: Because it involves gambling.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rosanna "Ria" V. Vergara
segments.text: And because it is designed by the developers to be addictive.

segments.speaker: Presentation video
segments.text: Kabilang din dito ang Blue Whale Challenge na nag-uudyok sa mga sumasali dito na saktan ang sarili at ang pinakamalala ay udyukan silang magpakamatay.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rosanna "Ria" V. Vergara
segments.text: Recently, a new social media game called Blue Whale was developed.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rosanna "Ria" V. Vergara
segments.text: The players are tasked to do 50 strange things.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rosanna "Ria" V. Vergara
segments.text: Hurting themselves, waking up at early hours to watch horror films, to win the game, commit suicide.

segments.speaker: Presentation video
segments.text: Kamakailan lamang, may isa na namang internet app na may kahalintulad na tema, ang Momo Challenge.

segments.speaker: Presentation video
segments.text: Nanawagan naman ngayon ang Philippine National Police sa mga magulang na bantayang mabuti ang kanilang mga anak sa paggamit ng internet.

segments.speaker: Presentation video
segments.text: Matapos ito sa nababalitang issue sa online na tinatawag na Momo Challenge.

segments.speaker: Presentation video
segments.text: Ang challenge ay naghihikayat sa mga bata na gumawa ng mga task kasama na rito ang pananakit sa sarili at pagpapakamatay.

segments.text: Totoo man o hindi?

segments.speaker: Presentation video
segments.text: Ang panganib.

segments.speaker: Presentation video
segments.text: Ang panganib na dala sa mga menor de edad ng computer gaming at internet ay mananatiling na riyan kung hindi natin mababantayan at gagabayan ang mga kabataan.
